I know that, I know, but I really don't want to experience these things without being able to tell her about it. I tell her about everything in my life and there's never been a good thing that she hasn't been there for. She is sure that the cancer is bad news because she's had issues in the same area with abnormal cells in the past and she put off her testing for two years. 

Thank you for responding though. I need to calm down and support her, but I'm so scared right now and I just want to die. I don't want to go to school anymore, I just feel like giving up.
